fix(runtime): fence agent recovery by lease generation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Require every Agent recovery request to carry the durable runnable-lease generation and refuse recovery before runner I/O unless the dispatch generation still owns a held lease.
    
    Track fake Agent process starts, resumes, and cancellations so the canonical A-E integration scenario asserts stale recovery performs no runner call and maximum process concurrency remains four.
